import re, html, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/inventory-file-qa-subcontract/')
result = {}
for filename in ('sba-subnet.html', 'sba-subnet-inventory.html'):
    raw = (root / 'raw' / filename).read_bytes()
    page = raw.decode()
    clean = lambda value: ' '.join(html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', value)).split())
    fields = [x for x in re.findall(r'<input\b[^>]*>', page, re.I) if re.search(r'name=["\']keyword["\']', x, re.I)]
    bodies = re.findall(r'<tbody\b[^>]*>(.*?)</tbody>', page, re.I | re.S)
    rows = [clean(x)[:350] for body in bodies for x in re.findall(r'<tr\b[^>]*>(.*?)</tr>', body, re.I | re.S)]
    notices = [clean(x) for x in re.findall(r'<(?:div|p)\b[^>]*>([^<>]*(?:no results|no opportunities|no records|no matching)[^<>]*)</(?:div|p)>', page, re.I)]
    result[filename] = dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), keyword_fields=fields, row_count=len(rows), row_examples=rows[:5], no_results_text=notices[:5])
out = root / 'director-subnet-inventory-filter.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(out.read_text())
